fields.name: missionFailed
fields.tooltip: The banner that slams onto the screen on every lost run, and the title of the retry panel that follows it.

fields.name: loseMissedRamp
fields.tooltip: Lose reason: the ship reached the end of the track with every objective met but not on one of the end ramps.

fields.name: loseTooSlow
fields.tooltip: Lose reason: the ship reached the end of the track without having reached Light Speed.

fields.name: loseObjectivesIncomplete
fields.tooltip: Lose reason: the ship reached the end of the track with an objective other than Light Speed still open.

fields.name: hudDistanceToEnd
fields.tooltip: The runner HUD's distance-to-the-end line. {0} = kilometres left.

fields.name: loseDestroyed
fields.tooltip: Lose reason: the ship's hull reached 0 and it exploded.

fields.name: pressAnyButton
fields.tooltip: The final GAME OVER's only prompt (the last life is gone, there is no retry): any key or button leads back to the Store.

fields.name: dashSinglePress
fields.tooltip: The CONTROLS page's toggle: ON = one press of a dash control dashes, OFF = the double tap.

fields.name: qteTooFast
fields.tooltip: HUD result label: pressed before the window.

fields.name: qteTooLate
fields.tooltip: HUD result label: pressed after the window, or not at all.

fields.name: qteSweet
fields.tooltip: HUD result label: inside the window.

fields.name: qtePerfect
fields.tooltip: HUD result label: the perfect band.

fields.name: missionAccomplished
fields.tooltip: The banner that slams onto the screen over the escaping ship the moment the win is sealed, before the debrief panel.

fields.name: spawnDensity
fields.tooltip: The debug menu's per-spawner density row. {0} = the spawner's name.
